issues.description: [suggestion] Quick-add "Recent meals" row for one-tap re-logging of frequently eaten foods. Problem: meal logging (FoodSearchSheet) requires a full search+select+qty flow every time, even for the same dal/roti/protein-shake a user eats daily — the highest-frequency action in the app has the highest friction, which is a known churn driver in nutrition trackers (MyFitnessPal/Cronometer both ship "recent" and "favorites" as their #1 speed feature). Evidence: grepped src/pages/_components/nutrition + components/plan-builder — no favorites/recent/quick-add/log-again surface exists anywhere in the logging flow today. Proposed v1: backend endpoint returning the user’s last 8 distinct logged foods (query existing meal-log table, group by food_id, order by last-logged desc) + a "Recent" chip row atop FoodSearchSheet; tapping re-logs the same food/qty at current time via the existing log-meal endpoint (no new write path). Effort: ~1 backend endpoint (S) + ~1 FE component insert (S), no schema change — half-day.
issues.author: shakeebshaan

issues.description: [suggestion] Injury-aware exercise substitution when a plan is paused for injury. Problem: PlanPauseScreen (src/pages/PlanPauseScreen.tsx) already has an "Injury" pause reason but only stores it as a label — no body-part capture and no downstream effect, so on resume the workout plan generator/coach can re-serve the exact movement that caused the injury (e.g. shoulder press after a shoulder injury). Evidence: REASONS array has injury as a flat enum value with no follow-up field; workout-plan generation and AI coach have no injury-exclusion input anywhere in the codebase. Comparable apps (Fitbod, Future) ask which body part and auto-avoid loading it. V1 scope: when reason=injury, show one extra step "Which area?" (shoulder/knee/back/wrist/ankle/other) + optional note; store on the pause record; on resume, pass the flagged body part(s) to the workout-plan builder/coach system prompt to exclude/soften exercises targeting that area for the first 1-2 weeks back, with a banner reminding the user to clear it manually if resolved sooner. Effort: ~1-2 days (1 new field + storage, 1 builder-prompt condition, 1 UI step).

issues.reviewReason: Thanks - internal-testing-track is the key detail. That track uses Play App Signing, so the installed app is signed with GOOGLE'S app-signing key, NOT your upload key. Google sign-in (Credential Manager) then fails on the Play-track build even though a sideloaded debug build works, because the OAuth client only trusts the upload-key SHA-1. Verified code-side is already correct: the v140 R8 keep-rules for Credential Manager are still in android/app/proguard-rules.pro (-keep com.google.android.libraries.identity.googleid.**, androidx.credentials.**, androidx.credentials.playservices.**), current build is versionCode 203 / 1.9.23. So this is a Console config fix, not code. Exact steps: (1) Play Console -> Test and release -> App integrity -> App signing -> copy the SHA-1 of the 'App signing key certificate'. (2) Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials -> the Android OAuth client for com.nyus.nyusand -> add that SHA-1 (keep the upload-key SHA-1 too). (3) Confirm the OAuth consent screen is Testing/Published and your tester email is on the testers list. (4) On the device, ensure Google Play services is up to date and the account is signed into the Play Store, then reinstall from the internal track (not a sideload). If it still fails after that, send me the exact on-screen text + the app version and I'll dig into the native path. (Same family as the earlier [16] reauth item 16b7 - that one was also App-Signing SHA-1 not on the OAuth client.)
issues.reviewReply: It it's from internal testing track

Exercise carries muscle_group_primary (indexed: chest/back/shoulders/legs/arms/core/full_body) + primary_muscles/muscle_groups_primary JSON. Build plan I'm executing: (1) Backend - in /activity/overview (and the session-complete summary) add session_muscle_volume: aggregate each logged set's reps*weight by the exercise's muscle_group_primary (fallback to primary_muscles[0]), returning [{group,volume_kg,set_count}] per session. Additive field, same low-risk pattern as the daily-volume fix I just shipped (i-20260713-4364). (2) Frontend - a compact per-muscle 'Volume by muscle group' breakdown on the Activity page under the existing Volume row (horizontal bars, domain-orange, tier-free per calm-gamification), plus the same on the post-workout summary. (3) Unit tests for the aggregation + FE render, then deploy + 390x844 capture proof. Building it next tick as a standalone so it ships clean and complete rather than rushed at the end of this one (this tick already shipped your daily-volume-target fix 4364 + board auto-archive). No action needed from you.

Plan: new recurring_activities table (user_id, name, type, schedule_kind, weekdays, start_time, duration_min, est_calories, active) + migration; an onboarding step after Health & Food ('Any activity you do regularly? e.g. 20-min treadmill after workouts') that's skippable; a 'Daily activity' card on /activity separate from the workout that auto-lists today's due recurring activities with a one-tap 'Done' that writes an ActivityLog(source='recurring'); designed to the calm/precise system (no arcade). Will deploy + 390x844 capture when it ships. Flagging only to record the defaults - no action needed unless you want to change (a)/(b)/(c).
